description: WSO2 SAP S/4HANA Master Inspection Characteristic provides a way to interact with the [Master Inspection Characteristic - Read API](https://api.sap.com/api/API_MASTERINSPCHARACTERISTIC_SRV/overview). The service allows to read master inspection characteristics, the master data records that describe the quality inspection criteria for materials, with their settings, control indicators and texts.
key-features: Read master inspection characteristics with their settings and control indicators
Read the language-dependent texts of master inspection characteristics
Filter, sort and page results with OData query options
